name: Lavanya Singh
paragraphs: I had the opportunity to work with Akash on couple of projects during my tenure at Onelab. Apart from the technical acumen that I have seen him build right from the  foundations to a Tech lead standards , he is extremely reliable specially when projects are going through turbulence. I have always seen him a active participant in technical as well as functional decisions. He is someone who will uplift a project from the get go.  One of my highly recommended FSD as an independent contributor or as Tech lead too.

name: Bart Spilt
paragraphs: I had the pleasure of working with Akash on the Brandhub project, and I highly recommend him as a skilled and dependable Software Engineer.

Akash is a strong problem-solver who takes ownership of his work and consistently delivers high-quality solutions. His proactive approach, attention to detail, and ability to handle complex challenges make him a valuable team member.

Beyond his technical abilities, he is collaborative, supportive, and always willing to help others. I strongly recommend Akash for Software Engineering roles and believe he would be a great addition to any engineering team.

name: Shubhankar Suley
relationship: Worked with me on the same team
paragraphs: Akash is a great developer with attention to detail. He is extremely hard working, he can handle anything from Frontend, Backend to UX design. I strongly recommend Akash!

name: Miraj Shaikh
relationship: Worked with me on the same team
paragraphs: Akash is someone I’m glad to know, and I’ve always appreciated his willingness to learn and improve. He’s dedicated to what he does, open to new challenges, and always brings a positive attitude.
He’s also a genuinely friendly and supportive person who’s easy to work with. I’m sure he’ll continue to grow and do great things in his career. Wishing him all the best for everything ahead

name: Narendraprasad Upadhyay
paragraphs: I had the pleasure of working with Akash on the Brandhub project at SMI Engine, and I can confidently recommend him as an outstanding full-stack developer.

Akash consistently demonstrates a high level of technical skill across both front-end and back-end work, delivering clean, reliable solutions under tight timelines. His commitment to quality is exceptional—he takes ownership of his tasks, proactively identifies risks, and ensures that deliverables meet or exceed expectations.

Beyond his technical abilities, Akash is a great resource to have around: collaborative, approachable, and always willing to support teammates. He raises the bar for everyone around him and would be a valuable addition to any engineering team.
I strongly recommend Akash for any full-stack or technical leadership role.
